subject.title: feat(android): add Wear OS app MVP

question: Should OpenClaw core adopt and maintain this first-party Wear OS companion app after the security, auth, CI, license, proof, and rebase blockers are fixed?
rationale: The branch adds a large native app surface with auth, network, storage, release, and maintenance ownership implications; code review can identify blockers, but only maintainers can decide whether core should own Wear support and who sponsors it.

options.title: Adopt With Android Owner Sponsorship
options.body: Keep this PR as the canonical Wear app candidate, require a clean rebase plus the listed blockers and stronger device proof, and have an Android owner sponsor the final shape.

options.title: Split Foundation From UI
options.body: Extract only shared gateway/proxy primitives maintainers want now, then defer the Wear UI to smaller follow-ups.

options.title: Close As Not Core-Owned
options.body: Close the first-party Wear proposal if maintainers do not want to own native Wear support in this repository.

recommendation.title: Adopt With Android Owner Sponsorship
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the canonical Wear app candidate, require a clean rebase plus the listed blockers and stronger device proof, and have an Android owner sponsor the final shape.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus is the live assignee and has direct branch context for the Wear gateway config work.
